Private study and qualification accumulation#

Qualification is a portable individual asset with value difference Δ=VE−VN\Delta=V_E-V_NΔ=VE​−VN​, while obsolescence returns experts to novice status at rate δ>0\delta>0δ>0. For a novice purchasing intensity x≥0x\ge0x≥0 at cost κx2/2\kappa x^2/2κx2/2, maximizing xΔ−κx2/2x\Delta-\kappa x^2/2xΔ−κx2/2 on the positive-value region gives the study choice in the first equation.

Practice arrives at per-novice rate M/(1−E)M/(1-E)M/(1−E), and paying Δ\DeltaΔ per successful transition cancels its private capital gain inside the novice’s value equation. Subtracting that equation from the expert’s equation leaves the wage premium, obsolescence, discounting, and optimized study surplus, producing the qualification-value law while practice remains present in physical accumulation.

Units keep these roles distinct because EEE is a population share, MMM is an aggregate transition flow, xxx is an individual intensity, and Δ\DeltaΔ is a stock of discounted value. With one expert clock hour supplied by each qualified person per unit of time, the same EEE also measures the expert labor available to services and research.

Stationary entry and incomplete replacement#

Within the strict diagnostic-portfolio comparison, the selected service modes retain their purchase margins while practice changes, giving an inverse wage w(E)>bw(E)>bw(E)>b independent of MMM and Δ\DeltaΔ. For a continuous nonincreasing wage schedule, stationary individual study decreases weakly with EEE, and aggregate formal transitions T(E)=(1−E)x(E)T(E)=(1-E)x(E)T(E)=(1−E)x(E) decrease strictly because the novice population also contracts.

Positive qualification drift at the lower feasible endpoint and negative drift at the upper endpoint give a unique stationary population for each practice flow in the comparison interval. At two such equilibria, subtracting their accumulation identities gives T1−T0=(M0−M1)−δ(E0−E1)T^1-T^0=(M^0-M^1)-\delta(E^0-E^1)T1−T0=(M0−M1)−δ(E0−E1), so a practice loss lowers expertise and induces strictly positive, incomplete formal replacement.

Validation, fees, and service demand#

For the service-quality extension, customers purchase cases from fixed franchises and face a generalized price PPP combining the fee with the certainty-equivalent loss from unresolved error. Each case needs generation time e(c)e(c)e(c), validation time vvv, and other resources k(c)k(c)k(c), while the error probability π(c)e−v\pi(c)e^{-v}π(c)e−v declines with expert checking, so the provider’s choice connects customer reliability to purchased professional judgment.

Complete methods and market clearing#

Positive coefficients vRv_RvR​ and mRm_RmR​ preserve the validation stage of each complete method, while qqq prices computation and ξ\xiξ measures computation used per human research hour. Human packets use aHa_HaH​ expert hours and autonomous packets use aMa_MaM​ computation units, with the feasible-method set F(A)\mathcal F(A)F(A) determining which costs procurement can compare.

Expert clearing joins customer services to human research, and the fixed expenditure flow BRB_RBR​ pays for human labor and all research computation. Completed packets advance the cardinal frontier AAA, while idea difficulty A−ϕA^{-\phi}A−ϕ reduces the increment supplied by each packet as the frontier grows, connecting improved research methods to a progressively harder innovation task.

Discovery and net preparation enter through γ\gammaγ, while βc\beta_cβc​ sets practice displacement, with both schedules independent of contemporaneous qualification value in this specialization.

Research prices are solved from clearing at each state, and the next chapter uses those prices to select a path with inherited population and frontier values and an explicit terminal career payoff. Through that boundary problem, the numerical comparison preserves the distinction between current market clearing and the future earnings used to finance study.
